name: io.github.mshark1/audio-mcp
title: Audio MCP
description: Audio perception for AI agents: measure, see, compare, edit and synthesize sound locally.

environmentVariables.name: AUDIO_MCP_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Optional sandbox: directories the server may read and write (separated by ';' on Windows, ':' elsewhere). Unset means unrestricted.

environmentVariables.name: AUDIO_MCP_MAX_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Optional: longest section (seconds) loaded into memory per call. Default 1800.
